statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); ∀ x p : ℕ, (window x p).Nonempty → ∃ m ∈ window x p, window x p = Finset.Icc m (2*x)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0020 · 确定素因子指数限制给出的窗口形状
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0020 · Identify the integer suffix cut out by the exponent threshold

brief.zh: 取最小合格整数，用 n ↦ n^132301 单调性证明其后每项都合格。
brief.en: Use the least eligible integer and monotonicity of the cutoff in n.
